### Career Evaluation Website
[Team project · AD688 Big Data and Cloud Analytics · In progress]{.project-meta}

A Quarto website that helps analytics job seekers compare roles, salaries and
skill demand in Computer Systems Design (NAICS 5415). I built the data pipeline
that filters 504,208 raw job postings down to a 1,790-posting, 12-month panel,
wrote the location and salary cleaning scripts (including a fix for Washington,
DC postings being counted as Washington State), and wrote the project's
literature review.

**Tools:** Python, PySpark, pandas, AWS EC2, Quarto, GitHub Pages

[Visit the team site](https://jennader.github.io/METAD688_Group2/){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}

### Job Market Analytics with Apache Spark
[Individual coursework · AD688 Big Data and Cloud Analytics]{.project-meta}

Two analyses of a large job postings dataset, run on an AWS EC2 instance. The
first models the data as a star schema in Spark SQL and answers four business
questions about salaries and demand across industries and states. The second
cleans the raw postings in PySpark, recovers years of experience from job
description text when the structured fields were blank, and charts salary
patterns by industry, education, experience and remote status.

**Tools:** PySpark, Spark SQL, Plotly, Quarto, AWS EC2
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}

### Zurich Airbnb Classification
[Team project · AD699 Data Mining for Business Analytics]{.project-meta}

Classification models built on 2,534 Zurich listings from Inside Airbnb. A
k-nearest neighbors model predicts whether a listing offers a dedicated
workspace, with k chosen by 10-fold cross-validation (60.8% test accuracy
against a 58.7% baseline). A pruned decision tree predicts how quickly hosts
respond across four classes, reaching 73.9% test accuracy against a 61.9%
baseline.

**Tools:** Python, scikit-learn, pandas, Jupyter
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}
<div class="project-icon"><i class="bi bi-gear-wide-connected"></i></div>

### Weekly Planning File Consolidation
[Work project · Royal Caribbean Group]{.project-meta}

A reusable Python script that combines ship-by-ship planning tabs into one clean
dataset each week. It uses fuzzy matching to line up port names that are
spelled differently across sources, so the combined file can be checked against
the itinerary system of record.

**Tools:** Python, pandas, fuzzy string matching
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .project-card}

### Guest Satisfaction Dashboard
[Work project · Royal Caribbean Group]{.project-meta}

A Power BI dashboard that tracks guest satisfaction scores, connected live to
Databricks through DirectQuery. I built the data model, the DAX measures and
the Power Query steps so the team can follow satisfaction results in one place
without exporting data by hand.

**Tools:** Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Databricks
:::
